description: MainActivity.java for an Android application demonstrating media routing, playback control, and media session management. It manages UI components for media library and playlist, media route discovery, and remote control integration.
external_files: Play services related libraries (implied by support library imports)

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing media routing, playback controls, UI interactions, and media session management.

classes.name: DiscoveryFragment
classes.description: Fragment to manage media route discovery and callbacks.

classes.name: MediaItem
classes.description: Class representing a media item with name, URI, and MIME type.

classes.name: PlaylistItem
classes.description: Class representing a playlist item with state, position, timestamp, item ID, duration, etc.

classes.name: LibraryAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for media library list, displaying available media items.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for playlist list, displaying current playlist items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up media routing, UI components, media lists, and media session.

methods.name: registerRemoteControlClient
methods.description: Sets up the RemoteControlClient for remote playback controls.

methods.name: handleMediaKey
methods.description: Handles media key events for playback controls.

methods.name: updateProgress
methods.description: Updates the SeekBar progress based on current playback position.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Refreshes the UI components based on current playback and routing state.

methods.name: updateRouteDescription
methods.description: Displays information about the currently selected media route.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Updates the state of playback control buttons.
